description:
Convert any URL's HTML into clean Markdown via the OpenGraph.io API (v3 markdown endpoint). Strips navigation, ads, and boilerplate by default — the result is main-content prose, headings, links, and images ready to read or feed into another model. Use `include_tags` / `exclude_tags` to target or remove specific page sections.

LONG PAGES — prefer retrieval over truncation. Set `query` with `chunking: true` to get back only the passages that answer your question (ranked by relevance) instead of the whole page. Use `max_chars` to cap raw output when you genuinely need prose. `chunk_size` and `chunk_overlap` tune the split; `heading_aware` keeps sections intact.

EXTRAS — `include_links`, `include_images`, and `include_headings` return structured link, image, and outline data, which avoids a second scrape call just to enumerate them.

UNTRUSTED CONTENT — this fetches arbitrary pages. Set `ai_sanitize: true` when the result will be fed to a model: it scans for prompt-injection attempts and returns a safety report. `ai_sanitize_mode: 'block'` rejects a risky page outright (HTTP 422) rather than returning it.

The Markdown text block is capped at 6 000 characters; the full content is always available in the structured `markdown` field.

Pick the right tool:
  getOgData        → Open Graph tags, social preview metadata (title, description, image, favicon)
  getOgMarkdown    → Clean readable text / article prose — ideal for feeding into an LLM
  getOgScrapeData  → Raw HTML — use when you need to do your own parsing or link extraction
  getOgExtract     → Targeted elements by tag (html_elements) or named CSS selectors (selectors)
  getOgScreenshot  → Visual capture of a page as an image
  getOgQuery       → Natural-language question answered from page content (100–200 credits/request)

accept_lang.description: Accept-Language header for the outbound request. Defaults to 'auto'.

ai_sanitize.description: Scan the fetched content for prompt-injection attempts and return a safety report.

ai_sanitize_mode.description: 'sanitize' cleans the content, 'warn' reports without changing it, 'block' returns HTTP 422. Only takes effect when ai_sanitize is true.

auto_proxy.description: Automatically escalate to a proxy if the direct request fails.

cache_ok.description: Use cached results. Set to false to bypass cache. Defaults to true.

chunk_overlap.description: Characters of overlap between consecutive chunks, for context. Max half of chunk_size.

chunk_size.description: Target characters per chunk (200–20000). Defaults to 2000.

chunking.description: Split the Markdown into chunks. Implied by `query`.

exclude_tags.description: CSS selectors to remove before conversion. Supports wildcard/regex patterns. Example: ['nav', 'footer', '.sidebar', '.ad*'].

full_render.description: Force full browser rendering before conversion. Rendering is applied automatically for pages detected as JavaScript-heavy; set this when that detection is insufficient.

heading_aware.description: Split on heading boundaries where possible, so sections stay intact. Defaults to true.

heading_aware_level.description: Deepest heading level treated as a split boundary (1–6). Defaults to 2.

include_chunks.description: Set false to get chunk counts in `usage` without the chunk bodies.

include_headings.description: Include the heading outline, plus table/code-block detection flags.

include_images.description: Include every image with its src and alt text.

include_links.description: Include every hyperlink with its text and rel attributes.

include_markdown.description: Set false to omit the prose body — useful when you only want structure or chunks.

include_metadata.description: Include page metadata (title, description, language, canonical URL). Defaults to true.

include_tags.description: CSS selectors — keep only elements matching these selectors. Example: ['article', 'main', '.content'] to target the main content area only.

load_more_clicks.description: Number of times to click the load_more_selector (1–10). Defaults to 3.

load_more_item_selector.description: CSS selector for the repeating item, used to detect when clicking stopped adding content.

load_more_scroll.description: Scroll between load_more clicks. Defaults to true.

load_more_selector.description: CSS selector for a 'load more' button to click before conversion.

load_more_wait.description: Milliseconds to wait after each load_more click (0–5000). Defaults to 1500.

max_cache_age.description: Maximum cache age in milliseconds. Defaults to 432000000 (5 days).

max_chars.description: Truncate the Markdown to this many characters. Prefer `query` + `chunking` when you want the relevant part of a long page rather than an arbitrary prefix.

max_chunks.description: Maximum chunks to return (1–2000). Defaults to 500.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts (1–4). Defaults to 4.

only_main_content.description: Heuristically strip navigation, header, footer, and ads, keeping only main prose content. Defaults to true server-side. Set to false to convert the full page.

proxy_country.description: Two-letter ISO country code for geo-targeted proxy exit node.

query.description: Natural-language question. Returns only the most relevant chunks, ranked (BM25), instead of the whole page. Requires chunking (enabled automatically when set).

query_top_k.description: How many ranked chunks to return when `query` is set. Defaults to 5.

retry_escalate.description: Escalate proxy tier on each retry attempt. Defaults to true.

scroll_to_bottom.description: Scroll to the bottom of the page before conversion. Forces full_render.

url.description: URL of the webpage to convert to Markdown.

use_premium.description: Route the request through a premium proxy.

use_proxy.description: Route the request through a standard proxy.

use_superior.description: Route the request through a superior-tier proxy.

wait_for_selector.description: CSS selector to wait for before converting. Forces full_render.

name: getOgMarkdown

ai_safety.description: Prompt-injection report; present when ai_sanitize is true

chunks.description: Chunk objects, ranked by relevance when `query` is set

debug.description: Whether rendering, a proxy, or retries were used

length.description: Character count of the returned Markdown

markdown.description: Full Markdown content of the page

metadata.description: Title, description, language, canonical and final URL
